info.description: The result of last-touch attribution when a referred user completes signup. One-shot: `referredUser` is unique, so a user cannot be re-attributed to a different affiliate after their account exists.

referralLinkClick.description: The specific click row that won last-touch attribution. Audit trail.

attributionIpHash.description: IP hash at attribution time (signup). Never exposed. Used only for post-hoc fraud clustering.

status.description: active = commissions accrue normally. pending_review = soft-flagged for admin review — weak signal like a shared IP; NO commissions until an admin approves. blocked = confirmed fraud or hard signal (same email/user id); commissions never accrue. churned = referred user inactive for a long time.

blockReason.description: Machine-readable reason a referral is not active. Only set when status != 'active'. Public — surfaces on both affiliate + admin dashboards so blocked referrals never appear without an explanation.
